title: 10-Year Treasury Note auction (December reopening) — the one coupon leg that stops the day before the 12-09 FOMC decision
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes, PDF CreationDate 2026-08-04), FlateDecode streams inflated PER PAGE and rows rebuilt from Tm coordinates. The page-3 row reads verbatim `10-Year NOTE / R / Thursday, December 03, 2026 / Tuesday, December 08, 2026 / Tuesday, December 15, 2026` — the `R` marks a REOPENING, so this sells more of an existing security rather than a new one. 1:00pm ET is Treasury's standing coupon-auction convention and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2026-12-03 coupon announcement
notes: DISCOVERED during the treasury-3y-note-2026-12-07 never-assessed initial research (2026-09-09), reading the same schedule PDF that dates that event. Filed because the calendar tracks treasury-10y-note-2026-09-09, -10-07 and -11-10 as first-class medium-impact entries and then stops — there is no canonical or proposed December 10-Year anywhere, and the November sibling (treasury-3y-note-2026-11-09) explicitly named this leg as discovered-but-not-filed so that a later sweep could file it. This is that sweep. WHY IT DESERVES ITS OWN LEDGER RATHER THAN A LINE IN THE 3-YEAR'S: it is the only coupon auction in the December block that stops at D-1 of the FOMC decision (`fomc-2026-12-09`, already tracked) — the 3-Year stops D-2 on Monday 12-07 and the 30-Year stops D+1 on Thursday 12-10, so the three legs straddle the meeting at three different distances, which is an unusually clean natural experiment for anyone testing FOMC-proximity effects on auction demand. A REOPENING, unlike its 3-Year block-mate: the security and its CUSIP already exist, so a when-issued level is quotable well before the auction, which is precisely the observability the 3-Year lacks. EXPECTED SIZE, per the grid rather than any published document: $42B, the standing 10-Year size behind Treasury's 'at least the next several quarters' language; the number becomes published on 2026-12-03 and the size decision itself belonged to the 2026-11-04 quarterly refunding statement. CORRIDOR: it prices into the same window as CPI (12-10), the government-funding deadline / CR expiry (12-11) and its own settlement (12-15). DISCOVERED IN THE SAME SWEEP AND FILED SEPARATELY: `treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-12-03` and `treasury-30y-bond-2026-12-10`. Proposed as an estimate; symbols: [] and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so nothing here licenses an entry.
